programs.title: Kung Fu Panda Holiday
programs.desc: Po's favorite holiday is approaching.Every year, the bear and his father hang decorations and cook delicacies for the villagers.This year's holidays turn out to be a big challenge for him, because he has to cope with the duties of the Dragon Warrior and become the host of a party organized only for kung-fu masters.Po finds out how difficult it will be to both fulfill his family obligations and not disappoint Master Shifu... In the Polish language version, they lent their voices to the following characters:Marcin Hycnar (Po), Jan Peszek (Shifu) and Wojciech Paszkowski (Po's father).

programs.title: Guess Who
programs.desc: Dark-skinned Percy (Bernie Mac) is the head of the Jones family and always knows what is best for his loved ones.He also has an opinion on what the future husband of his daughter, Theresa (Zoe Saldana), should be like.Unfortunately, so far none of her admirers have gained his recognition.When Theresa tells him about her new boyfriend, stockbroker Simon (Ashton Kutcher), her father finally seems to support her choice.However, at the first meeting, the good impression disappears.It turns out that Simon is... white.In addition, she does not ask Percy for her daughter's hand in marriage because he has already proposed to her.What's more, he wants to announce his engagement at the silver wedding of his future in-laws.Percy decides to make his daughter give up the marriage on her own.

programs.title: And Just Like That...
programs.desc: HBO 2 offers a diverse selection of high-quality films and family-friendly programming, serving as the perfect companion channel for around-the-clock movies.

programs.title: La Casa
programs.desc: After Antonio's death, his three adult children are preparing their holiday home for sale.However, every familiar corner brings back memories.They are increasingly afraid of breaking with the past.

programs.title: Detective Monk: One last thing
programs.desc: Brilliant detective Adrian Monk (Tony Shalhoub) is going through difficult times.The contract to publish his autobiography was canceled, and the coronavirus pandemic intensified his fears and phobias.All this makes the master of deduction start thinking about ending his life and joining his beloved Truda.He is jolted out of his torpor by the tragedy that befalls his stepdaughter Molly (Caitlin McGee).The girl is getting ready to marry journalist Griffin Briggs (Austin Scott).However, her fiancé dies while bungee jumping.Molly is convinced that it was not an accident, but a carefully planned murder.The trail leads to the influential billionaire Rick Eden (James Purefoy).Retired Captain Stottlemeyer (Ted Levine) now works for the rich man as his security chief.Monk's investigation is aided by former assistant and now real estate agent Natalie Teeger (Traylor Howard) and Randy Disher (Jason Gray-Stanford), now the New Jersey police commissioner.Continuation of the cult series.

programs.title: Broke
programs.desc: Former rodeo champion True cannot accept the end of his career.He is surprised by a violent blizzard.He fights for survival.

programs.title: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
programs.desc: The year is 1926. A slightly lost, nice Englishman, Newt Scamander, returns from an international research expedition, during which he had to find and describe as many species of fantastic animals as possible.He is carrying a mysterious suitcase with unknown contents.On the way he stops in New York.America is different from his homeland.It is forbidden to possess or transport magical creatures.Newt gets into trouble when it comes to light that his briefcase contains creatures considered dangerous.A researcher who is aware of their uniqueness does everything to ensure that they do not become extinct.Due to his inattention, several peculiar specimens find their way into the real world.Even more chaos is caused by a powerful force that threatens people's lives.Mr. Graves tries to erase the memories of people who witness her actions.The Muggle Jakub becomes involved in the course of events.Scamander must control the situation as quickly as possible and discover the source of the problem.

programs.title: Kung Fu Panda 4
programs.desc: Brave Po opens a new chapter in his life - he is to become the spiritual leader of the Valley of Peace.He's trying to get used to his new role.In addition, the voracious bear must find a daredevil who will replace him as the Dragon Warrior.Not everything goes according to plan.This time, China's security is threatened by Chameleon, who wields black magic and can take on any form and take over the abilities of old masters.With the help of a smart vixen and former thief, Zhen, the panda bear must face her.But they need allies to defeat the shape-shifting witch and the sinister army behind her.The time of a merciless fight is inevitably approaching... The voices of the characters include, among others:Marcin Hycnar, Jan Peszek, Wiktor Zborowski and Julia Chatys.

programs.title: Eileen
programs.desc: 1960s, Massachusetts.Eileen Dunlop (Thomasin McKenzie) works as a secretary at a reformatory for teenage boys.She lives with her widowed, alcohol-addicted father (Shea Whigham), a former police chief who suffers from paranoia and emotionally abuses her.The girl feels overwhelmed by anger and a sense of helplessness.He seeks refuge in the world of fantasy.The arrival of a new prison psychologist, the assertive and self-confident Rebecca (Anne Hathaway), causes her suppressed feelings to come to life.It seems that for the first time he has a chance for a real, deep relationship... The film's script is based on the novel by Ottessa Moshfegh.

programs.title: The Yogurt Shop Murders
programs.desc: The creators of the series investigate the circumstances of the shocking crime that occurred on December 6, 1991 in the city of Austin in the US state of Texas.Four teenage girls, 17-year-old Elize Thomas and Jennifer Harbison, who worked there, as well as the other's 15-year-old sister, Sarah, and her 13-year-old friend Amy Ayers, were murdered at a local ice cream shop overnight.Some of them were raped, and to cover up the traces, the killer set the place on fire.Although over 50 people, including the serial killer, confessed to the crime, the actual perpetrator has still not been identified.Witnesses testified that they saw two strange men in the ice cream parlor at night.

programs.title: U.S. Against The World: Four Years With The Men National Soccer Team
programs.desc: The story of the US men's national soccer team on its way to the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America. The film shows Christian Pulisic, Tyler Adams, Tim Weah and Weston McKennie personally and professionally.

programs.title: Blue Moon
programs.desc: The year is 1943. The legendary lyricist Lorenz Hart (Ethan Hawke), co-author of such hits as "Blue Moon" and "My Funny Valentine", spends the night from March 31 to April 1 in Sardi's bar.In the company of friends, including his muse Elizabeth Weiland (Margaret Qualley), he struggles with wounded pride and shaken self-confidence.At this time, his former long-time collaborator Richard Rodgers (Andrew Scott) celebrates the premiere of his musical entitled"Oklahoma!", which he wrote with Oscar Hammerstein II (Simon Delaney).Two Oscar nominations.
